# Historical SSR 190-r12 fixtures

These patches, helper, verifier and preparation function reproduce the former
190-r12 integration solely for the existing historical regression tests.
Production build code must never source or install this directory. The current
SSR v198.2 source, lifecycle, generator and integrity tests are in
`tests/test_ssrplus_v198.py` and `tests/test_ssrplus_build_gate.py`.
The original unmodified fixtures remain in `tests/fixtures/ssrplus/2abdc9aa`.
